name: ismember
comment: Sig [tf,loc]=ismember(A,B): tf membership mask + loc = LOWEST 1-based index of each A element in B (0 if absent). ismember([2 5 8 1],[5 2 9]) -> tf=[1 1 0 0], loc=[2 1 0 0]. Tie rule (B has dups): ismember([3 1 2],[2 1 3 1]) -> loc=[3 2 1] (lowest index). numkit previously had NO 2nd output loc -- added.
